# The Mathematical Model
This document provides a complex number based mathematical model.
## Sets and Parameters
### Sets

$$
\begin{aligned}
& N \text{ : buses} \\
& R \text{ : reference buses} \\
& E, E^R \text{ : branches, forward and reverse orientation} \\
& G, G_i \text{ : generators and generators at bus } i \\
& L, L_i \text{ : loads and loads at bus } i \\
& S, S_i \text{ : shunts and shunts at bus } i \\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Parameters

$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^{gl}_k, S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G  \text{ : generator complex power bounds} \\
& c_{2k}, c_{1k}, c_{0k} \quad \forall k \in G \text{ : generator cost components} \\
& v^l_i, v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \text{ : voltage bounds} \\
& S^d_k \quad \forall k \in L \text{ : load complex power consumption} \\
& Y^s_k \quad \forall k \in S \text{ : bus shunt admittance} \\
& Y_{ij}, Y^c_{ij}, Y^c_{ji} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch }\pi\text{-section parameters} \\
& T_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ :  branch complex transformation ratio} \\
& s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch apparent power limit} \\
& i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch current limit} \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij}, \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch voltage angle difference bounds}
\end{aligned}
$$


## Mathmatical Model

A complete mathematical model is as follows,
### Variables
$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^g_k \quad \forall k\in G  \text{ : generator complex power dispatch} \\
& V_i \quad \forall i\in N  \text{ : bus complex voltage} \\
& S_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \text{ : branch complex power flow} \\
\\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Formulation
$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{minimize:} &  
\sum_{k \in G} c_{2k} (\Re(S^g_k))^2 + c_{1k}\Re(S^g_k) + c_{0k} \\

\text{subject to:} & \\
& \angle V_{r} = 0 \quad \forall r \in R \\
& S^{gl}_k \leq S^g_k \leq S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G \\
& v^l_i \leq |V_i| \leq v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \\
& \sum_{k \in G_i} S^g_k - \sum_{k \in L_i} S^d_k - \sum_{k \in S_i} (Y^s_k)^* |V_i|^2 = \sum_{(i,j)\in E_i \cup E_i^R} S_{ij} \quad \forall i\in N \\
& S_{ij} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ij})^* \frac{|V_i|^2}{|T_{ij}|^2} - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V_i V^*_j}{T_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& S_{ji} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ji})^* |V_j|^2 - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V^*_i V_j}{T^*_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq |V_i| i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij} \leq \angle (V_i V^*_j) \leq \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E
\end{aligned}
$$

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
AC Optimal Power Flow Solver
Implements the mathematical model from math-model.md using scipy.optimize.

The model uses complex voltage representation internally but outputs
real/reactive power and voltage magnitude/angle in the report.
"""

import json
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize, NonlinearConstraint
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')


def load_network(filepath):
    """Load network data from MATPOWER-format JSON file."""
    with open(filepath, 'r') as f:
        data = json.load(f)

    baseMVA = data['baseMVA']

    # Parse bus data
    # [BUS_I, TYPE, PD, QD, GS, BS, AREA, VM, VA, BASE_KV, ZONE, VMAX, VMIN]
    buses = []
    for b in data['bus']:
        buses.append({
            'id': int(b[0]),
            'type': int(b[1]),  # 1=PQ, 2=PV, 3=Slack
            'pd': b[2] / baseMVA,  # Convert to per unit
            'qd': b[3] / baseMVA,
            'gs': b[4] / baseMVA,  # Shunt conductance
            'bs': b[5] / baseMVA,  # Shunt susceptance
            'vm': b[7],
            'va': np.radians(b[8]),
            'vmax': b[11],
            'vmin': b[12]
        })

    # Create bus id to index mapping
    bus_id_to_idx = {bus['id']: i for i, bus in enumerate(buses)}

    # Parse generator data
    # [GEN_BUS, PG, QG, QMAX, QMIN, VG, MBASE, STATUS, PMAX, PMIN]
    generators = []
    for g in data['gen']:
        if g[7] == 1:  # Only include in-service generators
            generators.append({
                'bus': int(g[0]),
                'bus_idx': bus_id_to_idx[int(g[0])],
                'pg': g[1] / baseMVA,
                'qg': g[2] / baseMVA,
                'qmax': g[3] / baseMVA,
                'qmin': g[4] / baseMVA,
                'vg': g[5],
                'pmax': g[8] / baseMVA,
                'pmin': g[9] / baseMVA
            })

    # Parse branch data
    # [F_BUS, T_BUS, R, X, B, RATE_A, RATE_B, RATE_C, TAP, SHIFT, STATUS, ANGMIN, ANGMAX]
    branches = []
    for br in data['branch']:
        if br[10] == 1:  # Only include in-service branches
            tap = br[8] if br[8] != 0 else 1.0
            branches.append({
                'from_bus': int(br[0]),
                'to_bus': int(br[1]),
                'from_idx': bus_id_to_idx[int(br[0])],
                'to_idx': bus_id_to_idx[int(br[1])],
                'r': br[2],
                'x': br[3],
                'b': br[4],  # Total line charging susceptance
                'rate_a': br[5] / baseMVA if br[5] > 0 else 9999,  # MVA limit in pu
                'tap': tap,
                'shift': np.radians(br[9]),
                'angmin': np.radians(br[11]),
                'angmax': np.radians(br[12])
            })

    # Parse generator cost data
    # [MODEL, STARTUP, SHUTDOWN, NCOST, COST...]
    # For polynomial (MODEL=2): costs are c2, c1, c0 for 3 coefficients
    gencost = []
    gen_idx = 0
    for gc in data['gencost']:
        if gen_idx >= len(generators):
            break
        model = int(gc[0])
        ncost = int(gc[3])
        if model == 2:  # Polynomial cost
            costs = gc[4:4+ncost]
            if ncost == 3:
                c2, c1, c0 = costs[0], costs[1], costs[2]
            elif ncost == 2:
                c2, c1, c0 = 0, costs[0], costs[1]
            else:
                c2, c1, c0 = 0, 0, costs[0] if ncost >= 1 else 0
            # Costs need to be scaled for per-unit power
            # Original: c2*Pg^2 + c1*Pg + c0 where Pg in MW
            # In pu: c2*(Pg_pu*baseMVA)^2 + c1*(Pg_pu*baseMVA) + c0
            #      = c2*baseMVA^2*Pg_pu^2 + c1*baseMVA*Pg_pu + c0
            gencost.append({
                'c2': c2 * baseMVA**2,
                'c1': c1 * baseMVA,
                'c0': c0
            })
        else:
            # Piecewise linear - approximate with quadratic
            gencost.append({'c2': 0, 'c1': 1.0 * baseMVA, 'c0': 0})
        gen_idx += 1

    return {
        'baseMVA': baseMVA,
        'buses': buses,
        'generators': generators,
        'branches': branches,
        'gencost': gencost,
        'bus_id_to_idx': bus_id_to_idx
    }


def build_ybus(network):
    """Build the bus admittance matrix."""
    n_bus = len(network['buses'])
    Y = np.zeros((n_bus, n_bus), dtype=complex)

    for br in network['branches']:
        i = br['from_idx']
        j = br['to_idx']
        r, x = br['r'], br['x']
        b_ch = br['b']  # Total line charging
        tap = br['tap']
        shift = br['shift']

        # Series admittance
        if r == 0 and x == 0:
            y_s = 0
        else:
            y_s = 1.0 / complex(r, x)

        # Shunt admittance (line charging split between ends)
        y_ch = 1j * b_ch / 2

        # Complex tap ratio
        t = tap * np.exp(1j * shift)
        t_conj = np.conj(t)
        t_mag_sq = np.abs(t)**2

        # Add to Y matrix (pi-model with tap)
        Y[i, i] += (y_s + y_ch) / t_mag_sq
        Y[j, j] += y_s + y_ch
        Y[i, j] -= y_s / t_conj
        Y[j, i] -= y_s / t

    # Add shunt elements at buses
    for bus in network['buses']:
        idx = network['bus_id_to_idx'][bus['id']]
        Y[idx, idx] += complex(bus['gs'], bus['bs'])

    return Y


def compute_branch_flows(V, network):
    """Compute complex power flows in branches."""
    flows = []
    for br in network['branches']:
        i = br['from_idx']
        j = br['to_idx']
        r, x = br['r'], br['x']
        b_ch = br['b']
        tap = br['tap']
        shift = br['shift']

        Vi = V[i]
        Vj = V[j]

        if r == 0 and x == 0:
            y_s = 0
        else:
            y_s = 1.0 / complex(r, x)

        y_ch = 1j * b_ch / 2
        t = tap * np.exp(1j * shift)
        t_conj = np.conj(t)
        t_mag_sq = np.abs(t)**2

        # Power flow from i to j
        # S_ij = V_i * conj(I_ij)
        # I_ij = (V_i/t - V_j) * y_s + V_i/t * y_ch/t_mag
        I_ij = (Vi/t - Vj) * y_s + Vi * y_ch / t_mag_sq
        S_ij = Vi * np.conj(I_ij)

        # Power flow from j to i
        I_ji = (Vj - Vi/t) * y_s + Vj * y_ch
        S_ji = Vj * np.conj(I_ji)

        flows.append({
            'from_bus': br['from_bus'],
            'to_bus': br['to_bus'],
            'S_ij': S_ij,
            'S_ji': S_ji,
            'rate_a': br['rate_a']
        })

    return flows


def solve_acopf(network):
    """
    Solve AC Optimal Power Flow using scipy.optimize.

    Variables (flattened):
    - Pg[ng]: Real power generation for each generator
    - Qg[ng]: Reactive power generation for each generator
    - Vm[nb]: Voltage magnitude at each bus
    - Va[nb]: Voltage angle at each bus
    """
    buses = network['buses']
    generators = network['generators']
    branches = network['branches']
    gencost = network['gencost']
    Y = build_ybus(network)

    nb = len(buses)
    ng = len(generators)

    # Variable indices
    # x = [Pg(0:ng), Qg(ng:2*ng), Vm(2*ng:2*ng+nb), Va(2*ng+nb:2*ng+2*nb)]
    nvar = 2*ng + 2*nb

    # Find reference bus (type 3)
    ref_buses = [i for i, bus in enumerate(buses) if bus['type'] == 3]
    if not ref_buses:
        ref_buses = [0]

    # Create generator-to-bus mapping
    gen_at_bus = {i: [] for i in range(nb)}
    for g_idx, gen in enumerate(generators):
        gen_at_bus[gen['bus_idx']].append(g_idx)

    # Initial point
    x0 = np.zeros(nvar)
    for g_idx, gen in enumerate(generators):
        x0[g_idx] = (gen['pmin'] + gen['pmax']) / 2  # Pg
        x0[ng + g_idx] = 0  # Qg
    for b_idx, bus in enumerate(buses):
        x0[2*ng + b_idx] = 1.0  # Vm
        x0[2*ng + nb + b_idx] = 0.0  # Va

    # Variable bounds
    lb = np.zeros(nvar)
    ub = np.zeros(nvar)
    for g_idx, gen in enumerate(generators):
        lb[g_idx] = gen['pmin']
        ub[g_idx] = gen['pmax']
        lb[ng + g_idx] = gen['qmin']
        ub[ng + g_idx] = gen['qmax']
    for b_idx, bus in enumerate(buses):
        lb[2*ng + b_idx] = bus['vmin']
        ub[2*ng + b_idx] = bus['vmax']
        lb[2*ng + nb + b_idx] = -np.pi
        ub[2*ng + nb + b_idx] = np.pi

    # Fix reference bus angle
    for ref in ref_buses:
        lb[2*ng + nb + ref] = 0
        ub[2*ng + nb + ref] = 0

    bounds = list(zip(lb, ub))

    def objective(x):
        """Minimize total generation cost."""
        cost = 0
        for g_idx in range(ng):
            Pg = x[g_idx]
            c2 = gencost[g_idx]['c2']
            c1 = gencost[g_idx]['c1']
            c0 = gencost[g_idx]['c0']
            cost += c2 * Pg**2 + c1 * Pg + c0
        return cost

    def objective_grad(x):
        """Gradient of objective."""
        grad = np.zeros(nvar)
        for g_idx in range(ng):
            Pg = x[g_idx]
            c2 = gencost[g_idx]['c2']
            c1 = gencost[g_idx]['c1']
            grad[g_idx] = 2 * c2 * Pg + c1
        return grad

    def power_balance(x):
        """Power balance equality constraints.
        Returns residuals for P and Q at each bus.
        """
        Pg = x[:ng]
        Qg = x[ng:2*ng]
        Vm = x[2*ng:2*ng+nb]
        Va = x[2*ng+nb:]

        # Complex voltage
        V = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va)

        # Calculate injected power from Y matrix
        S_inj = V * np.conj(Y @ V)

        residuals = np.zeros(2*nb)
        for b_idx, bus in enumerate(buses):
            # Generation at this bus
            Pg_bus = sum(Pg[g_idx] for g_idx in gen_at_bus[b_idx])
            Qg_bus = sum(Qg[g_idx] for g_idx in gen_at_bus[b_idx])

            # Load at this bus
            Pd = bus['pd']
            Qd = bus['qd']

            # Power balance: Generation - Load = Injection
            residuals[b_idx] = Pg_bus - Pd - S_inj[b_idx].real
            residuals[nb + b_idx] = Qg_bus - Qd - S_inj[b_idx].imag

        return residuals

    def branch_limits(x):
        """Branch flow limit inequality constraints.
        Returns apparent power flow - limit for each branch direction.
        Should be <= 0 for feasibility.
        """
        Vm = x[2*ng:2*ng+nb]
        Va = x[2*ng+nb:]
        V = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va)

        violations = []
        for br in branches:
            i = br['from_idx']
            j = br['to_idx']
            r, x_b = br['r'], br['x']
            b_ch = br['b']
            tap = br['tap']
            shift = br['shift']

            Vi = V[i]
            Vj = V[j]

            if r == 0 and x_b == 0:
                y_s = 0
            else:
                y_s = 1.0 / complex(r, x_b)

            y_ch = 1j * b_ch / 2
            t = tap * np.exp(1j * shift)
            t_conj = np.conj(t)
            t_mag_sq = np.abs(t)**2

            I_ij = (Vi/t - Vj) * y_s + Vi * y_ch / t_mag_sq
            S_ij = Vi * np.conj(I_ij)

            I_ji = (Vj - Vi/t) * y_s + Vj * y_ch
            S_ji = Vj * np.conj(I_ji)

            violations.append(np.abs(S_ij) - br['rate_a'])
            violations.append(np.abs(S_ji) - br['rate_a'])

        return np.array(violations)

    def angle_diff_limits(x):
        """Angle difference constraints.
        angmin <= Va_i - Va_j <= angmax
        Returns [Va_i - Va_j - angmin, angmax - (Va_i - Va_j)]
        Both should be >= 0
        """
        Va = x[2*ng+nb:]
        residuals = []
        for br in branches:
            i = br['from_idx']
            j = br['to_idx']
            diff = Va[i] - Va[j]
            residuals.append(diff - br['angmin'])
            residuals.append(br['angmax'] - diff)
        return np.array(residuals)

    # Set up constraints
    eq_constraint = {'type': 'eq', 'fun': power_balance}

    ineq_constraints = [
        {'type': 'ineq', 'fun': lambda x: -branch_limits(x)},  # <= 0 means -f(x) >= 0
        {'type': 'ineq', 'fun': angle_diff_limits}
    ]

    constraints = [eq_constraint] + ineq_constraints

    print("Starting AC-OPF optimization...")
    print(f"  Buses: {nb}, Generators: {ng}, Branches: {len(branches)}")
    print(f"  Variables: {nvar}, Equality constraints: {2*nb}, Inequality constraints: {4*len(branches)}")

    # Solve
    result = minimize(
        objective,
        x0,
        method='SLSQP',
        jac=objective_grad,
        bounds=bounds,
        constraints=constraints,
        options={'maxiter': 1000, 'ftol': 1e-6, 'disp': True}
    )

    if not result.success:
        print(f"Warning: Optimization did not converge: {result.message}")
        # Try with trust-constr as backup
        print("Trying trust-constr method...")

        eq_constr = NonlinearConstraint(power_balance, 0, 0)
        ineq_constr1 = NonlinearConstraint(branch_limits, -np.inf, 0)
        ineq_constr2 = NonlinearConstraint(angle_diff_limits, 0, np.inf)

        result = minimize(
            objective,
            x0,
            method='trust-constr',
            jac=objective_grad,
            bounds=bounds,
            constraints=[eq_constr, ineq_constr1, ineq_constr2],
            options={'maxiter': 1000, 'verbose': 2}
        )

    # Extract solution
    x_opt = result.x
    Pg = x_opt[:ng]
    Qg = x_opt[ng:2*ng]
    Vm = x_opt[2*ng:2*ng+nb]
    Va = x_opt[2*ng+nb:]

    return {
        'success': result.success,
        'message': result.message,
        'cost': result.fun,
        'Pg': Pg,
        'Qg': Qg,
        'Vm': Vm,
        'Va': Va,
        'x': x_opt
    }


def generate_report(network, solution, output_path):
    """Generate the JSON report."""
    baseMVA = network['baseMVA']
    buses = network['buses']
    generators = network['generators']
    branches = network['branches']

    Pg = solution['Pg']
    Qg = solution['Qg']
    Vm = solution['Vm']
    Va = solution['Va']

    # Convert to SI units
    Pg_MW = Pg * baseMVA
    Qg_MVAr = Qg * baseMVA
    Va_deg = np.degrees(Va)

    # Calculate total load
    total_load_MW = sum(bus['pd'] for bus in buses) * baseMVA
    total_load_MVAr = sum(bus['qd'] for bus in buses) * baseMVA

    # Calculate total generation
    total_gen_MW = sum(Pg_MW)
    total_gen_MVAr = sum(Qg_MVAr)

    # Calculate losses
    total_losses_MW = total_gen_MW - total_load_MW

    # Compute branch flows for the report
    V = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va)
    branch_flows = compute_branch_flows(V, network)

    # Find most loaded branches
    branch_loading = []
    for idx, flow in enumerate(branch_flows):
        S_ij = flow['S_ij'] * baseMVA
        S_ji = flow['S_ji'] * baseMVA
        rate_a = flow['rate_a'] * baseMVA

        flow_from_MVA = np.abs(S_ij)
        flow_to_MVA = np.abs(S_ji)
        max_flow = max(flow_from_MVA, flow_to_MVA)
        loading_pct = (max_flow / rate_a) * 100 if rate_a > 0 else 0

        branch_loading.append({
            'from_bus': flow['from_bus'],
            'to_bus': flow['to_bus'],
            'loading_pct': round(loading_pct, 2),
            'flow_from_MVA': round(flow_from_MVA, 2),
            'flow_to_MVA': round(flow_to_MVA, 2),
            'limit_MVA': round(rate_a, 2)
        })

    # Sort by loading percentage and get top 10
    branch_loading.sort(key=lambda x: x['loading_pct'], reverse=True)
    most_loaded = branch_loading[:10]

    # Check power balance residuals
    Y = build_ybus(network)
    S_inj = V * np.conj(Y @ V)

    gen_at_bus = {i: [] for i in range(len(buses))}
    for g_idx, gen in enumerate(generators):
        gen_at_bus[gen['bus_idx']].append(g_idx)

    max_p_mismatch = 0
    max_q_mismatch = 0
    for b_idx, bus in enumerate(buses):
        Pg_bus = sum(Pg[g_idx] for g_idx in gen_at_bus[b_idx])
        Qg_bus = sum(Qg[g_idx] for g_idx in gen_at_bus[b_idx])

        p_mismatch = abs(Pg_bus - bus['pd'] - S_inj[b_idx].real) * baseMVA
        q_mismatch = abs(Qg_bus - bus['qd'] - S_inj[b_idx].imag) * baseMVA

        max_p_mismatch = max(max_p_mismatch, p_mismatch)
        max_q_mismatch = max(max_q_mismatch, q_mismatch)

    # Check voltage violations
    max_v_violation = 0
    for b_idx, bus in enumerate(buses):
        if Vm[b_idx] < bus['vmin']:
            max_v_violation = max(max_v_violation, bus['vmin'] - Vm[b_idx])
        elif Vm[b_idx] > bus['vmax']:
            max_v_violation = max(max_v_violation, Vm[b_idx] - bus['vmax'])

    # Check branch overloads
    max_overload = 0
    for bl in branch_loading:
        if bl['loading_pct'] > 100:
            overload = max(bl['flow_from_MVA'], bl['flow_to_MVA']) - bl['limit_MVA']
            max_overload = max(max_overload, overload)

    # Build report
    report = {
        'summary': {
            'total_cost_per_hour': round(solution['cost'], 2),
            'total_load_MW': round(total_load_MW, 2),
            'total_load_MVAr': round(total_load_MVAr, 2),
            'total_generation_MW': round(total_gen_MW, 2),
            'total_generation_MVAr': round(total_gen_MVAr, 2),
            'total_losses_MW': round(total_losses_MW, 2),
            'solver_status': 'optimal' if solution['success'] else 'suboptimal'
        },
        'generators': [
            {
                'id': g_idx + 1,
                'bus': gen['bus'],
                'pg_MW': round(Pg_MW[g_idx], 2),
                'qg_MVAr': round(Qg_MVAr[g_idx], 2),
                'pmin_MW': round(gen['pmin'] * baseMVA, 2),
                'pmax_MW': round(gen['pmax'] * baseMVA, 2),
                'qmin_MVAr': round(gen['qmin'] * baseMVA, 2),
                'qmax_MVAr': round(gen['qmax'] * baseMVA, 2)
            }
            for g_idx, gen in enumerate(generators)
        ],
        'buses': [
            {
                'id': bus['id'],
                'vm_pu': round(Vm[b_idx], 4),
                'va_deg': round(Va_deg[b_idx], 2),
                'vmin_pu': bus['vmin'],
                'vmax_pu': bus['vmax']
            }
            for b_idx, bus in enumerate(buses)
        ],
        'most_loaded_branches': most_loaded,
        'feasibility_check': {
            'max_p_mismatch_MW': round(max_p_mismatch, 6),
            'max_q_mismatch_MVAr': round(max_q_mismatch, 6),
            'max_voltage_violation_pu': round(max_v_violation, 6),
            'max_branch_overload_MVA': round(max_overload, 2)
        }
    }

    with open(output_path, 'w') as f:
        json.dump(report, f, indent=2)

    return report


def main():
    print("=" * 60)
    print("AC Optimal Power Flow Solver")
    print("=" * 60)

    # Load network
    print("\nLoading network data...")
    network = load_network('/root/network.json')
    print(f"  Loaded {len(network['buses'])} buses, {len(network['generators'])} generators, {len(network['branches'])} branches")

    # Solve AC-OPF
    print("\nSolving AC-OPF...")
    solution = solve_acopf(network)

    # Generate report
    print("\nGenerating report...")
    report = generate_report(network, solution, '/root/report.json')

    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("RESULTS SUMMARY")
    print("=" * 60)
    print(f"  Status: {report['summary']['solver_status']}")
    print(f"  Total Cost: ${report['summary']['total_cost_per_hour']:,.2f}/hr")
    print(f"  Total Load: {report['summary']['total_load_MW']:.2f} MW, {report['summary']['total_load_MVAr']:.2f} MVAr")
    print(f"  Total Generation: {report['summary']['total_generation_MW']:.2f} MW, {report['summary']['total_generation_MVAr']:.2f} MVAr")
    print(f"  Total Losses: {report['summary']['total_losses_MW']:.2f} MW")
    print(f"\nFeasibility Check:")
    print(f"  Max P mismatch: {report['feasibility_check']['max_p_mismatch_MW']:.6f} MW")
    print(f"  Max Q mismatch: {report['feasibility_check']['max_q_mismatch_MVAr']:.6f} MVAr")
    print(f"  Max V violation: {report['feasibility_check']['max_voltage_violation_pu']:.6f} pu")
    print(f"  Max branch overload: {report['feasibility_check']['max_branch_overload_MVA']:.2f} MVA")
    print("\nReport saved to: /root/report.json")

    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
AC Optimal Power Flow Solver
Implements the mathematical model from math-model.md using scipy.optimize.

The model uses complex voltage representation internally but outputs
real/reactive power and voltage magnitude/angle in the report.
"""

import json
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize, NonlinearConstraint
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')


def load_network(filepath):
    """Load network data from MATPOWER-format JSON file."""
    with open(filepath, 'r') as f:
        data = json.load(f)

    baseMVA = data['baseMVA']

    # Parse bus data
    # [BUS_I, TYPE, PD, QD, GS, BS, AREA, VM, VA, BASE_KV, ZONE, VMAX, VMIN]
    buses = []
    for b in data['bus']:
        buses.append({
            'id': int(b[0]),
            'type': int(b[1]),  # 1=PQ, 2=PV, 3=Slack
            'pd': b[2] / baseMVA,  # Convert to per unit
            'qd': b[3] / baseMVA,
            'gs': b[4] / baseMVA,  # Shunt conductance
            'bs': b[5] / baseMVA,  # Shunt susceptance
            'vm': b[7],
            'va': np.radians(b[8]),
            'vmax': b[11],
            'vmin': b[12]
        })

    # Create bus id to index mapping
    bus_id_to_idx = {bus['id']: i for i, bus in enumerate(buses)}

    # Parse generator data
    # [GEN_BUS, PG, QG, QMAX, QMIN, VG, MBASE, STATUS, PMAX, PMIN]
    generators = []
    for g in data['gen']:
        if g[7] == 1:  # Only include in-service generators
            generators.append({
                'bus': int(g[0]),
                'bus_idx': bus_id_to_idx[int(g[0])],
                'pg': g[1] / baseMVA,
                'qg': g[2] / baseMVA,
                'qmax': g[3] / baseMVA,
                'qmin': g[4] / baseMVA,
                'vg': g[5],
                'pmax': g[8] / baseMVA,
                'pmin': g[9] / baseMVA
            })

    # Parse branch data
    # [F_BUS, T_BUS, R, X, B, RATE_A, RATE_B, RATE_C, TAP, SHIFT, STATUS, ANGMIN, ANGMAX]
    branches = []
    for br in data['branch']:
        if br[10] == 1:  # Only include in-service branches
            tap = br[8] if br[8] != 0 else 1.0
            branches.append({
                'from_bus': int(br[0]),
                'to_bus': int(br[1]),
                'from_idx': bus_id_to_idx[int(br[0])],
                'to_idx': bus_id_to_idx[int(br[1])],
                'r': br[2],
                'x': br[3],
                'b': br[4],  # Total line charging susceptance
                'rate_a': br[5] / baseMVA if br[5] > 0 else 9999,  # MVA limit in pu
                'tap': tap,
                'shift': np.radians(br[9]),
                'angmin': np.radians(br[11]),
                'angmax': np.radians(br[12])
            })

    # Parse generator cost data
    # [MODEL, STARTUP, SHUTDOWN, NCOST, COST...]
    # For polynomial (MODEL=2): costs are c2, c1, c0 for 3 coefficients
    gencost = []
    gen_idx = 0
    for gc in data['gencost']:
        if gen_idx >= len(generators):
            break
        model = int(gc[0])
        ncost = int(gc[3])
        if model == 2:  # Polynomial cost
            costs = gc[4:4+ncost]
            if ncost == 3:
                c2, c1, c0 = costs[0], costs[1], costs[2]
            elif ncost == 2:
                c2, c1, c0 = 0, costs[0], costs[1]
            else:
                c2, c1, c0 = 0, 0, costs[0] if ncost >= 1 else 0
            # Costs need to be scaled for per-unit power
            # Original: c2*Pg^2 + c1*Pg + c0 where Pg in MW
            # In pu: c2*(Pg_pu*baseMVA)^2 + c1*(Pg_pu*baseMVA) + c0
            #      = c2*baseMVA^2*Pg_pu^2 + c1*baseMVA*Pg_pu + c0
            gencost.append({
                'c2': c2 * baseMVA**2,
                'c1': c1 * baseMVA,
                'c0': c0
            })
        else:
            # Piecewise linear - approximate with quadratic
            gencost.append({'c2': 0, 'c1': 1.0 * baseMVA, 'c0': 0})
        gen_idx += 1

    return {
        'baseMVA': baseMVA,
        'buses': buses,
        'generators': generators,
        'branches': branches,
        'gencost': gencost,
        'bus_id_to_idx': bus_id_to_idx
    }


def build_ybus(network):
    """Build the bus admittance matrix."""
    n_bus = len(network['buses'])
    Y = np.zeros((n_bus, n_bus), dtype=complex)

    for br in network['branches']:
        i = br['from_idx']
        j = br['to_idx']
        r, x = br['r'], br['x']
        b_ch = br['b']  # Total line charging
        tap = br['tap']
        shift = br['shift']

        # Series admittance
        if r == 0 and x == 0:
            y_s = 0
        else:
            y_s = 1.0 / complex(r, x)

        # Shunt admittance (line charging split between ends)
        y_ch = 1j * b_ch / 2

        # Complex tap ratio
        t = tap * np.exp(1j * shift)
        t_conj = np.conj(t)
        t_mag_sq = np.abs(t)**2

        # Add to Y matrix (pi-model with tap)
        Y[i, i] += (y_s + y_ch) / t_mag_sq
        Y[j, j] += y_s + y_ch
        Y[i, j] -= y_s / t_conj
        Y[j, i] -= y_s / t

    # Add shunt elements at buses
    for bus in network['buses']:
        idx = network['bus_id_to_idx'][bus['id']]
        Y[idx, idx] += complex(bus['gs'], bus['bs'])

    return Y


def compute_branch_flows(V, network):
    """Compute complex power flows in branches."""
    flows = []
    for br in network['branches']:
        i = br['from_idx']
        j = br['to_idx']
        r, x = br['r'], br['x']
        b_ch = br['b']
        tap = br['tap']
        shift = br['shift']

        Vi = V[i]
        Vj = V[j]

        if r == 0 and x == 0:
            y_s = 0
        else:
            y_s = 1.0 / complex(r, x)

        y_ch = 1j * b_ch / 2
        t = tap * np.exp(1j * shift)
        t_conj = np.conj(t)
        t_mag_sq = np.abs(t)**2

        # Power flow from i to j
        # S_ij = V_i * conj(I_ij)
        # I_ij = (V_i/t - V_j) * y_s + V_i/t * y_ch/t_mag
        I_ij = (Vi/t - Vj) * y_s + Vi * y_ch / t_mag_sq
        S_ij = Vi * np.conj(I_ij)

        # Power flow from j to i
        I_ji = (Vj - Vi/t) * y_s + Vj * y_ch
        S_ji = Vj * np.conj(I_ji)

        flows.append({
            'from_bus': br['from_bus'],
            'to_bus': br['to_bus'],
            'S_ij': S_ij,
            'S_ji': S_ji,
            'rate_a': br['rate_a']
        })

    return flows


def solve_acopf(network):
    """
    Solve AC Optimal Power Flow using scipy.optimize.

    Variables (flattened):
    - Pg[ng]: Real power generation for each generator
    - Qg[ng]: Reactive power generation for each generator
    - Vm[nb]: Voltage magnitude at each bus
    - Va[nb]: Voltage angle at each bus
    """
    buses = network['buses']
    generators = network['generators']
    branches = network['branches']
    gencost = network['gencost']
    Y = build_ybus(network)

    nb = len(buses)
    ng = len(generators)

    # Variable indices
    # x = [Pg(0:ng), Qg(ng:2*ng), Vm(2*ng:2*ng+nb), Va(2*ng+nb:2*ng+2*nb)]
    nvar = 2*ng + 2*nb

    # Find reference bus (type 3)
    ref_buses = [i for i, bus in enumerate(buses) if bus['type'] == 3]
    if not ref_buses:
        ref_buses = [0]

    # Create generator-to-bus mapping
    gen_at_bus = {i: [] for i in range(nb)}
    for g_idx, gen in enumerate(generators):
        gen_at_bus[gen['bus_idx']].append(g_idx)

    # Initial point
    x0 = np.zeros(nvar)
    for g_idx, gen in enumerate(generators):
        x0[g_idx] = (gen['pmin'] + gen['pmax']) / 2  # Pg
        x0[ng + g_idx] = 0  # Qg
    for b_idx, bus in enumerate(buses):
        x0[2*ng + b_idx] = 1.0  # Vm
        x0[2*ng + nb + b_idx] = 0.0  # Va

    # Variable bounds
    lb = np.zeros(nvar)
    ub = np.zeros(nvar)
    for g_idx, gen in enumerate(generators):
        lb[g_idx] = gen['pmin']
        ub[g_idx] = gen['pmax']
        lb[ng + g_idx] = gen['qmin']
        ub[ng + g_idx] = gen['qmax']
    for b_idx, bus in enumerate(buses):
        lb[2*ng + b_idx] = bus['vmin']
        ub[2*ng + b_idx] = bus['vmax']
        lb[2*ng + nb + b_idx] = -np.pi
        ub[2*ng + nb + b_idx] = np.pi

    # Fix reference bus angle
    for ref in ref_buses:
        lb[2*ng + nb + ref] = 0
        ub[2*ng + nb + ref] = 0

    bounds = list(zip(lb, ub))

    def objective(x):
        """Minimize total generation cost."""
        cost = 0
        for g_idx in range(ng):
            Pg = x[g_idx]
            c2 = gencost[g_idx]['c2']
            c1 = gencost[g_idx]['c1']
            c0 = gencost[g_idx]['c0']
            cost += c2 * Pg**2 + c1 * Pg + c0
        return cost

    def objective_grad(x):
        """Gradient of objective."""
        grad = np.zeros(nvar)
        for g_idx in range(ng):
            Pg = x[g_idx]
            c2 = gencost[g_idx]['c2']
            c1 = gencost[g_idx]['c1']
            grad[g_idx] = 2 * c2 * Pg + c1
        return grad

    def power_balance(x):
        """Power balance equality constraints.
        Returns residuals for P and Q at each bus.
        """
        Pg = x[:ng]
        Qg = x[ng:2*ng]
        Vm = x[2*ng:2*ng+nb]
        Va = x[2*ng+nb:]

        # Complex voltage
        V = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va)

        # Calculate injected power from Y matrix
        S_inj = V * np.conj(Y @ V)

        residuals = np.zeros(2*nb)
        for b_idx, bus in enumerate(buses):
            # Generation at this bus
            Pg_bus = sum(Pg[g_idx] for g_idx in gen_at_bus[b_idx])
            Qg_bus = sum(Qg[g_idx] for g_idx in gen_at_bus[b_idx])

            # Load at this bus
            Pd = bus['pd']
            Qd = bus['qd']

            # Power balance: Generation - Load = Injection
            residuals[b_idx] = Pg_bus - Pd - S_inj[b_idx].real
            residuals[nb + b_idx] = Qg_bus - Qd - S_inj[b_idx].imag

        return residuals

    def branch_limits(x):
        """Branch flow limit inequality constraints.
        Returns apparent power flow - limit for each branch direction.
        Should be <= 0 for feasibility.
        """
        Vm = x[2*ng:2*ng+nb]
        Va = x[2*ng+nb:]
        V = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va)

        violations = []
        for br in branches:
            i = br['from_idx']
            j = br['to_idx']
            r, x_b = br['r'], br['x']
            b_ch = br['b']
            tap = br['tap']
            shift = br['shift']

            Vi = V[i]
            Vj = V[j]

            if r == 0 and x_b == 0:
                y_s = 0
            else:
                y_s = 1.0 / complex(r, x_b)

            y_ch = 1j * b_ch / 2
            t = tap * np.exp(1j * shift)
            t_conj = np.conj(t)
            t_mag_sq = np.abs(t)**2

            I_ij = (Vi/t - Vj) * y_s + Vi * y_ch / t_mag_sq
            S_ij = Vi * np.conj(I_ij)

            I_ji = (Vj - Vi/t) * y_s + Vj * y_ch
            S_ji = Vj * np.conj(I_ji)

            violations.append(np.abs(S_ij) - br['rate_a'])
            violations.append(np.abs(S_ji) - br['rate_a'])

        return np.array(violations)

    def angle_diff_limits(x):
        """Angle difference constraints.
        angmin <= Va_i - Va_j <= angmax
        Returns [Va_i - Va_j - angmin, angmax - (Va_i - Va_j)]
        Both should be >= 0
        """
        Va = x[2*ng+nb:]
        residuals = []
        for br in branches:
            i = br['from_idx']
            j = br['to_idx']
            diff = Va[i] - Va[j]
            residuals.append(diff - br['angmin'])
            residuals.append(br['angmax'] - diff)
        return np.array(residuals)

    # Set up constraints
    eq_constraint = {'type': 'eq', 'fun': power_balance}

    ineq_constraints = [
        {'type': 'ineq', 'fun': lambda x: -branch_limits(x)},  # <= 0 means -f(x) >= 0
        {'type': 'ineq', 'fun': angle_diff_limits}
    ]

    constraints = [eq_constraint] + ineq_constraints

    print("Starting AC-OPF optimization...")
    print(f"  Buses: {nb}, Generators: {ng}, Branches: {len(branches)}")
    print(f"  Variables: {nvar}, Equality constraints: {2*nb}, Inequality constraints: {4*len(branches)}")

    # Solve
    result = minimize(
        objective,
        x0,
        method='SLSQP',
        jac=objective_grad,
        bounds=bounds,
        constraints=constraints,
        options={'maxiter': 1000, 'ftol': 1e-6, 'disp': True}
    )

    if not result.success:
        print(f"Warning: Optimization did not converge: {result.message}")
        # Try with trust-constr as backup
        print("Trying trust-constr method...")

        eq_constr = NonlinearConstraint(power_balance, 0, 0)
        ineq_constr1 = NonlinearConstraint(branch_limits, -np.inf, 0)
        ineq_constr2 = NonlinearConstraint(angle_diff_limits, 0, np.inf)

        result = minimize(
            objective,
            x0,
            method='trust-constr',
            jac=objective_grad,
            bounds=bounds,
            constraints=[eq_constr, ineq_constr1, ineq_constr2],
            options={'maxiter': 1000, 'verbose': 2}
        )

    # Extract solution
    x_opt = result.x
    Pg = x_opt[:ng]
    Qg = x_opt[ng:2*ng]
    Vm = x_opt[2*ng:2*ng+nb]
    Va = x_opt[2*ng+nb:]

    return {
        'success': result.success,
        'message': result.message,
        'cost': result.fun,
        'Pg': Pg,
        'Qg': Qg,
        'Vm': Vm,
        'Va': Va,
        'x': x_opt
    }


def generate_report(network, solution, output_path):
    """Generate the JSON report."""
    baseMVA = network['baseMVA']
    buses = network['buses']
    generators = network['generators']
    branches = network['branches']

    Pg = solution['Pg']
    Qg = solution['Qg']
    Vm = solution['Vm']
    Va = solution['Va']

    # Convert to SI units
    Pg_MW = Pg * baseMVA
    Qg_MVAr = Qg * baseMVA
    Va_deg = np.degrees(Va)

    # Calculate total load
    total_load_MW = sum(bus['pd'] for bus in buses) * baseMVA
    total_load_MVAr = sum(bus['qd'] for bus in buses) * baseMVA

    # Calculate total generation
    total_gen_MW = sum(Pg_MW)
    total_gen_MVAr = sum(Qg_MVAr)

    # Calculate losses
    total_losses_MW = total_gen_MW - total_load_MW

    # Compute branch flows for the report
    V = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va)
    branch_flows = compute_branch_flows(V, network)

    # Find most loaded branches
    branch_loading = []
    for idx, flow in enumerate(branch_flows):
        S_ij = flow['S_ij'] * baseMVA
        S_ji = flow['S_ji'] * baseMVA
        rate_a = flow['rate_a'] * baseMVA

        flow_from_MVA = np.abs(S_ij)
        flow_to_MVA = np.abs(S_ji)
        max_flow = max(flow_from_MVA, flow_to_MVA)
        loading_pct = (max_flow / rate_a) * 100 if rate_a > 0 else 0

        branch_loading.append({
            'from_bus': flow['from_bus'],
            'to_bus': flow['to_bus'],
            'loading_pct': round(loading_pct, 2),
            'flow_from_MVA': round(flow_from_MVA, 2),
            'flow_to_MVA': round(flow_to_MVA, 2),
            'limit_MVA': round(rate_a, 2)
        })

    # Sort by loading percentage and get top 10
    branch_loading.sort(key=lambda x: x['loading_pct'], reverse=True)
    most_loaded = branch_loading[:10]

    # Check power balance residuals
    Y = build_ybus(network)
    S_inj = V * np.conj(Y @ V)

    gen_at_bus = {i: [] for i in range(len(buses))}
    for g_idx, gen in enumerate(generators):
        gen_at_bus[gen['bus_idx']].append(g_idx)

    max_p_mismatch = 0
    max_q_mismatch = 0
    for b_idx, bus in enumerate(buses):
        Pg_bus = sum(Pg[g_idx] for g_idx in gen_at_bus[b_idx])
        Qg_bus = sum(Qg[g_idx] for g_idx in gen_at_bus[b_idx])

        p_mismatch = abs(Pg_bus - bus['pd'] - S_inj[b_idx].real) * baseMVA
        q_mismatch = abs(Qg_bus - bus['qd'] - S_inj[b_idx].imag) * baseMVA

        max_p_mismatch = max(max_p_mismatch, p_mismatch)
        max_q_mismatch = max(max_q_mismatch, q_mismatch)

    # Check voltage violations
    max_v_violation = 0
    for b_idx, bus in enumerate(buses):
        if Vm[b_idx] < bus['vmin']:
            max_v_violation = max(max_v_violation, bus['vmin'] - Vm[b_idx])
        elif Vm[b_idx] > bus['vmax']:
            max_v_violation = max(max_v_violation, Vm[b_idx] - bus['vmax'])

    # Check branch overloads
    max_overload = 0
    for bl in branch_loading:
        if bl['loading_pct'] > 100:
            overload = max(bl['flow_from_MVA'], bl['flow_to_MVA']) - bl['limit_MVA']
            max_overload = max(max_overload, overload)

    # Build report
    report = {
        'summary': {
            'total_cost_per_hour': round(solution['cost'], 2),
            'total_load_MW': round(total_load_MW, 2),
            'total_load_MVAr': round(total_load_MVAr, 2),
            'total_generation_MW': round(total_gen_MW, 2),
            'total_generation_MVAr': round(total_gen_MVAr, 2),
            'total_losses_MW': round(total_losses_MW, 2),
            'solver_status': 'optimal' if solution['success'] else 'suboptimal'
        },
        'generators': [
            {
                'id': g_idx + 1,
                'bus': gen['bus'],
                'pg_MW': round(Pg_MW[g_idx], 2),
                'qg_MVAr': round(Qg_MVAr[g_idx], 2),
                'pmin_MW': round(gen['pmin'] * baseMVA, 2),
                'pmax_MW': round(gen['pmax'] * baseMVA, 2),
                'qmin_MVAr': round(gen['qmin'] * baseMVA, 2),
                'qmax_MVAr': round(gen['qmax'] * baseMVA, 2)
            }
            for g_idx, gen in enumerate(generators)
        ],
        'buses': [
            {
                'id': bus['id'],
                'vm_pu': round(Vm[b_idx], 4),
                'va_deg': round(Va_deg[b_idx], 2),
                'vmin_pu': bus['vmin'],
                'vmax_pu': bus['vmax']
            }
            for b_idx, bus in enumerate(buses)
        ],
        'most_loaded_branches': most_loaded,
        'feasibility_check': {
            'max_p_mismatch_MW': round(max_p_mismatch, 6),
            'max_q_mismatch_MVAr': round(max_q_mismatch, 6),
            'max_voltage_violation_pu': round(max_v_violation, 6),
            'max_branch_overload_MVA': round(max_overload, 2)
        }
    }

    with open(output_path, 'w') as f:
        json.dump(report, f, indent=2)

    return report


def main():
    print("=" * 60)
    print("AC Optimal Power Flow Solver")
    print("=" * 60)

    # Load network
    print("\nLoading network data...")
    network = load_network('/root/network.json')
    print(f"  Loaded {len(network['buses'])} buses, {len(network['generators'])} generators, {len(network['branches'])} branches")

    # Solve AC-OPF
    print("\nSolving AC-OPF...")
    solution = solve_acopf(network)

    # Generate report
    print("\nGenerating report...")
    report = generate_report(network, solution, '/root/report.json')

    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("RESULTS SUMMARY")
    print("=" * 60)
    print(f"  Status: {report['summary']['solver_status']}")
    print(f"  Total Cost: ${report['summary']['total_cost_per_hour']:,.2f}/hr")
    print(f"  Total Load: {report['summary']['total_load_MW']:.2f} MW, {report['summary']['total_load_MVAr']:.2f} MVAr")
    print(f"  Total Generation: {report['summary']['total_generation_MW']:.2f} MW, {report['summary']['total_generation_MVAr']:.2f} MVAr")
    print(f"  Total Losses: {report['summary']['total_losses_MW']:.2f} MW")
    print(f"\nFeasibility Check:")
    print(f"  Max P mismatch: {report['feasibility_check']['max_p_mismatch_MW']:.6f} MW")
    print(f"  Max Q mismatch: {report['feasibility_check']['max_q_mismatch_MVAr']:.6f} MVAr")
    print(f"  Max V violation: {report['feasibility_check']['max_voltage_violation_pu']:.6f} pu")
    print(f"  Max branch overload: {report['feasibility_check']['max_branch_overload_MVA']:.2f} MVA")
    print("\nReport saved to: /root/report.json")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
